user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College Borough Boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a registered polygon dataset representing the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available dataset candidate representing the State College borough boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject Borough Boundary to Tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Convert the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918 for compatible spatial overlay with the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not guess the source CRS; request clarification if the source CRS is not explicitly available.

workflow_steps.title: Intersect Census Tracts with State College Borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create polygon zones for the portions of census tracts that intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a polygon intersection between the census tract layer and the reprojected State College borough boundary. Preserve tract identifiers and retain only intersecting tract geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject DEM to EPSG:26918
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the elevation raster with the census tract zone CRS for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the DEM from its known EPSG:3857 CRS to EPSG:26918 while preserving the elevation values.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate Mean Elevation by Intersecting Tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize mean DEM elevation for each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean elevation from the reprojected DEM for each polygon zone in the intersecting tract layer, retaining the tract identifier in the summary table.

requirements.scope: The retrieved State College borough boundary must have an explicitly reported source CRS before reprojection.
